text:
rachel.t: Hi everyone, first day and ran into a weird one. I accepted the Okta invite but it created a second account for me (rachel.t+personal@redwood.com) instead of using rachel.t@redwood.com. Now I can't access any internal docs.

olivia-peopleops: Welcome Rachel! :wave: Sorry about that. Sometimes Google account aliases or an extra sign-up step creates a dup. Can you confirm which email you clicked the invite from?

rachel.t: I clicked the link from personal inbox (rachel.t+personal@gmail.com) because I hadn't seen the company email yet. Company email is rachel.t@redwood.com.

idm-bot: Duplicate account detected: accountsFound=2. Admin action required to merge or deactivate duplicates. Run `/okta-admin list-user rachel.t` to inspect.

sam-it: Hi Rachel 1 We can merge the two Okta identities but SCIM/1Password mapping can be finicky. Quick plan: I'll deactivate the stray account, then force SCIM re-provision for your company identity so 1Password and Google groups attach properly.

mara-eng: FYI if you already used the personal account to claim GitHub SSO it might leave you without repo access after we merge. We'll re-add you to the repos once your primary identity is active.

olivia-peopleops: I'm revoking the invite for the personal address now and re-sending to rachel.t@redwood.com. Please accept only the company one.

idm-bot: Action log: invite_revoked for rachel.t+personal@gmail.com at 2026-03-23T12:00:01Z. New invite sent to rachel.t@redwood.com.

rachel.t: Got the new invite and accepted, but Okta prompted me to enroll MFA and the passkey setup offered my personal Apple passkey by default. I canceled and tried to choose "Use another account" but it still picked personal.

sam-it: Thanks for flagging. Short-term: open an incognito window and accept the invite there so the browser doesn't auto-fill a personal passkey. Long-term: we can clear the attestation mapping for the personal passkey from the stray account.

mara-eng: Also if you add TOTP as backup (1Password or Authy) that tends to be smoother for repo access during re-provisioning.

olivia-peopleops: 1Password provisioning should happen automatically once Okta shows you as ACTIVE and in the 'employees' SCIM group. If it doesn't happen in 10m, reply here and I'll trigger a manual SCIM sync.

sam-it: I've deactivated the personal Okta account and forced a SCIM sync for rachel.t@redwood.com. You should get a 1Password invite and Google Drive shares shortly.

idm-bot: SCIM sync complete for user rachel.t@redwood.com. Provisioning status: 1Password=queued, GoogleGroups=applied.

rachel.t: 1Password invite arrived! Set up TOTP there and managed to enroll a new passkey tied to my company Apple ID. Logged into Confluence too. Thanks! :relieved:

mara-eng: Welcome aboard Rachel! Ping me if you want the onboarding checklist for the infra team.

olivia-peopleops: Closing loop: old stray account is deactivated. If you notice missing permissions (GitHub/org access), tag @mara-eng or @sam-it and we'll restore. :sparkles:
